create_base_agent: create a BaseAgent instance to act as a passive scripted agent for StarCraft II
setup_base_agent: setup a BaseAgent with observation and action specs from the game environment
reset_base_agent: reset a BaseAgent to increment the episode counter for a new game run
step_base_agent: step a BaseAgent with an observation to return a no-op action call
review_base_agent: review the BaseAgent class and its methods for building custom scripted agents
